title: Digital-Twin & Synthetic-Data Partner/Vendor Integration Framework
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (synthetic clinical data / AI test enablement; data-engineering/simulation/governance work, privacy care).

Synthetic-data & digital-twin tools (e.g. Synthea, commercial platforms) and AI/model frameworks integrated at the pattern level; vendor internals cited or deferred, never invented. Regulatory/legal interpretation (HIPAA/HITRUST de-identification, IRB/privacy sign-off, disclosure risk) deferred to privacy/compliance/legal. Never real PHI in a shared harness/twin/AI test env. Automation is Python.
hook: Bring partner twin & synthetic-data capabilities in — without lock-in
problem: Digital-twin and synthetic-data capabilities often come from partners — and integrating them well, across programs, without lock-in is the hard part. This solution defines the partner/vendor integration framework: how to evaluate digital-twin and synthetic-data vendors, the integration patterns to plug them into your harness and AI test environments, data/interface contracts, and anti-lock-in criteria — so partner capabilities are leveraged consistently and remain portable.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the integration model for external twin/synthetic-data capabilities: evaluation, integration patterns, data/interface contracts, portability.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (candidate vendors, your harness/test env, governance, evaluation criteria).
Implementation Guide — the vendor-evaluation method, the named integration patterns (data in/out, interface contracts), anti-lock-in/portability criteria, and a pilot integration, then expand.

5 Python tools — assessment/profiling, generation or scenario execution, a fidelity/coverage report, a privacy/validation check, and a scope/config helper — authentic to synthetic-data engineering (safe by default; no real PHI written to shared locations).
Testing/validation gates (integrated, portable, governed) plus Best Practices for durable, low-lock-in partner integration.
short: Define the partner/vendor integration framework for digital-twin & synthetic-data capabilities — evaluation, integration patterns, data/interface contracts, and anti-lock-in — so partner capabilities are leveraged consistently and stay portable. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.

bottom_line: Partner digital-twin and synthetic-data capabilities leveraged across programs — integrated consistently, contract-defined, and portable — without vendor lock-in.
